name: MCPS Information Technology Foundation (Network Operations)
note: Re-verified 2026-09-08 and reclassified out of scope: the district's own page describes a for-credit CTE course sequence leading to certifications and college credit, not a workplace-based placement. The carried-forward row and its history are retained.

offerings.summary: A high school course sequence in computer repair and networking that leads to CompTIA A+ and Network+ certifications and nine college credits; students also refurbish and sell used computers as part of the class.

loc.venue: Thomas Edison High School of Technology and Clarksburg High School

grades.raw: All high school students in Montgomery County Public Schools (MCPS) are eligible

school.raw: All high school students in Montgomery County Public Schools (MCPS) are eligible

app.instructions: At Thomas Edison, complete the school's application and then specify the course codes when registering for classes; at Clarksburg, see your counsellor to enrol.

issues: This is a for-credit class, and classes are outside the scope test in P01/P24. The service learning hours and computer refurbishment sit inside the course rather than at an employer.

sources.title: Enroll | Thomas Edison High School of Technology

evidence.quote: Earn valuable industry-standard CompTIA certifications (A+/Network+) in computer repair and computer networking ... Earn 9 college credits in computer repair and networking while still in high school ... Earn 15 Student Service Learning (SSL) hours
All high school students in Montgomery County Public Schools (MCPS) are eligible
